Has a range of 14. |ability1_cooldown = 5 }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Clown''' is an enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a high amount of health and a slightly fast speed when there are no towers in its range, though it gets slower when there is a tower in its range. It will throw bombs at towers, which apply a 200% [[Fatigue Debuff]] to them and the nearby towers for 3 seconds, also dealing 80 damage to units. ==Appearance== The '''Clown''' is a humanoid with a light green skin tone and wears a stereotypical carnival clown outfit. It has a yellow striped shirt with short white sleeves, red striped overalls with blue straps and red shoes with white markings. It also has a red nose, red clown-styled hair and a blue and white neck ruff. It walks on a large blue and red pattern ball. It holds a dark purple bomb with a white question mark on it. The '''Clown''' has a death animation, where it will trip and fall onto the ball on its back, dropping its bomb in the process. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Pursuit]] are quite effective against this. **Multiple early-game oriented towers, like the [[Golden Cowboy]], [[Brawler]], [[Trapper]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] can also be useful against it. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting their firerate and range respectively. *The [[Commander]] can be useful at partially mitigating the '''Clown's''' [[Fatigue Debuff]]. *Keep in mind that the '''Clown''' is able to hit all towers, including cliff and flying towers. *The [[Medic]] cannot be used to block its debuff, as its shield does not block debuffs. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseClown.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Game Master Ultimate Skin - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Clown''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ClownLunarIndex.png|'''Clown''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **'''Clown''' added. **{{Bug}} Ball does not move in the [[Index]]. **{{Bug}} Ball is not affected by [[Time Scale]]. *'''29 January 2025''' - [[v1.51.0]] **Cash given increased from {{Money|1,200}} to {{Money|1,500}} upon death. *'''11 June 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **{{Bug}} Explosions no longer appear. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. {{PizzaParty|[[Marionette]]|Wave 16|Clown|Wave 18|[[Knight]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
